theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_eil_near_optimal_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℝ) (A : Set X) (r ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ d → 0 < r → 0 < ε → (μH[d] : Measure X) A ≠ ∞ → ∃ S : ℕ → Set X, (∀ i, S i ⊆ A) ∧ A ⊆ ⋃ i, S i ∧ (∀ i, ediam (S i) ≤ r) ∧ ∑' i, ⨆ (_ : (S i).Nonempty), ediam (S i) ^ d ≤ (μH[d] : Measure X) A + ε
